craftPunchList.issue: .fs-cke-add ('+ Add step/section' utility links) render in color:var(--accent); they stack with the open-card accent border (.fs-cke-card.is-open :10), the accent 'Customized by…' badge (:29-32) and the gold Save button — an open, customized card shows 4+ simultaneous gold marks, far over the ≤2 budget. §5 requires utility actions to be neutral.
craftPunchList.fix: Render the '+ Add' links as neutral/tertiary ink; reserve gold for the single primary action plus at most one selection accent per view.

craftPunchList.issue: System-filter chips hardcode v3 color-code jargon as user-facing labels: {key:'gold',label:'Gold'} / {key:'grey',label:'Grey'}. This is §8's canonical example ('Gold (LongShore)'→'LongShore') and the shared SYSTEM_LABELS map already exists; the chip text prints the internal color enum in the results sheet.
craftPunchList.fix: Route the chip label through SYSTEM_LABELS (Gold→LongShore, Grey→Acme thread) via a sysKey→System lookup; the StrutSysKey stays the dot's color identity but the visible text must be the system name.

craftPunchList.issue: 'Deployed' is painted gold at two altitudes at once: the stat-strip deployed figure (.fs-inv-stat--accent b→--accent) AND every partially-deployed row's 'N deployed' dot badge (EquipmentRow.tsx:51 tone='accent'). Stacked with the primary 'Add equipment' button and the selected scope tab, a heavily-deployed rig shows 7+ gold moments. Not a hard violation (Inventory is the accepted exemplar) — a consolidation candidate.
craftPunchList.fix: Confirm with Alex: demote the stat-strip 'deployed' figure to neutral ink (--text-primary) since the per-row chips already carry the status accent — leaving primary + selection + one status-accent family.

craftPunchList.issue: The three sibling stock-state chips are built two ways: 'running low' and 'N deployed' use <Badge variant="dot"> but 'all N deployed' (out) is a hand-rolled <span class="fs-inv-chip-out"> with bespoke CSS (off-grid padding 3px 10px). Filled-pill-vs-dot may be a deliberate severity escalation but the divergent implementation is an inconsistency.
craftPunchList.fix: Confirm the filled-pill escalation is intended; if so, add a solid/danger Badge tone so all three states flow through <Badge> and inherit tokenized padding.

craftPunchList.issue: .fs-cke-card composes only border + border-radius + overflow:hidden — a bare chrome outline. It omits background:var(--surface-card) and the box-shadow lift, so the checklist container is an outlined box rather than an elevated card.
craftPunchList.fix: Apply the §3 card recipe: surface-card background + a single-token box-shadow with a [data-theme='sunlight'] override (single-token, to avoid the comma-list 'none' drop trap).

craftPunchList.issue: .fs-cke-handle drag grip is 28×40px — both dimensions under the 56px hit floor, and it is the sole drag surface for reordering.
craftPunchList.fix: Keep the 16px grip glyph but extend the touch/hit box to ≥56px via padding / expanded hit box, not by enlarging the visible grip.

craftPunchList.issue: .fs-cke-text (Edit / Remove / Reset buttons) is --type-caption with only --space-1 vertical padding (~24-28px tall); parent .fs-cke-row min-height is only 44px.
craftPunchList.fix: Expand these buttons' hit areas to ≥56px via padding / expanded hit box while keeping the light caption weight.

craftPunchList.issue: systemLabel() returns the v3 color-code words 'Gold'/'Grey' and renders them as the system sublabel (.fs-inv-summary-system). systemLabels.ts (SYSTEM_LABELS) exists specifically to kill these.
craftPunchList.fix: Route the sublabel through SYSTEM_LABELS from @ui/inventory/systemLabels ('LongShore' / 'Acme thread' / 'LockStroke'); never the raw color word.

craftPunchList.issue: SYS_WORD maps kind→'Gold'/'Grey'/'LockStroke' and renders 'Gold · LongShore' at :248 (the exact 'Gold (LongShore)' pattern §8 rewrites to 'LongShore') and leads the identity headline at :271.

craftPunchList.issue: The inventory companion panel floods with accent: .fs-inv-summary-rig-name is accent text + a 2px accent bottom-border PER RIG, and .fs-inv-summary-system is accent text PER ROW. motionFixes.recommendation: #435 decision — DELETE the transition and snap the width to its computed value each tick. This also fixes the reduced-motion escape: the literal 1s bypasses the :1200-1205 reduce guard (only .fs-org-node/.fs-org-gap-bar are covered) so the OP bar keeps animating for reduced-motion users.
Snap 160ms to var(--motion-transition) (180ms, nearest on-scale step) and name the animated props (width, border-radius, opacity) instead of `all`.

Draw the per-card stagger increment from a documented motion token (mint --motion-stagger) rather than raw 45ms; leave the animation duration on var(--motion-status). Do not snap to 100ms — too large for a per-card stagger.

statStripVerdict.evidence: Only the value-figure font is shared; orientation, label token, casing, and states all diverge. Container: ops .fs-ops-stats = display:flex; gap:var(--space-5); padding-top:var(--space-1); no wrap. command .fs-cmd-stats = display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; column-gap:var(--space-5); row-gap:var(--space-1). Figure orientation (biggest divergence): ops .fs-ops-stat = flex-direction:column; gap:1px (value stacked ABOVE label); command .fs-cmd-statfig = inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:var(--space-1) (value BESIDE label). Value: both var(--type-mono-stat)+tabular-nums+--text-primary — identical; but command adds [data-zero]→--text-tertiary dim and a --accent variant that ops lacks. Label: ops .fs-ops-stat-k = var(--type-label)+letter-spacing:0.06em+text-transform:uppercase; command .fs-cmd-stat-k = var(--type-caption), no tracking, no uppercase. A shared StatStrip primitive would need to reconcile figure orientation (column-stack vs inline-baseline), label token (label-uppercase-tracked vs caption-plain), and command's zero-dim + accent states — so the StatStrip build is ON, not skipped.

topRecommendations: Land the sunlight white-on-white ink fixes first (30 bugs across all 6 screens) — fold them into the in-flight sunlight-fix commit. These are field-safety tells that vanish under glare: the Cutting Station 64px cut-length numeral + hero border, the over-capacity/gated recommendation bars, the lagging-Division ⚠ + border (whose own comment relies on the ⚠ still carrying the message), and the assigned org-node dot (which also inverts salience vs the still-visible staged dot). Pattern: pair every standalone --*-text ink with a [data-theme='sunlight'] override to the matching --*-bg, mirroring the command.css :362-393 exemplar cluster; the .fs-assign-notice one is the inverse (dark-on-dark) and should switch to --sp-text on --sp-bg.

Mint the missing mono type-ramp step(s) and route every off-ramp data numeral through them — Quick Find's 34px measurement input, the Ops rec-ledger 1rem + detail-hero 2rem figures, and the Cutting queue count. This is the exact numeral-ramp gap #435 was named to close, and the code already self-flags the 1rem ledger for it.

Kill the v3 color-code copy leak (§8) at all three sites — SystemFilter chips (high, user-visible in the results sheet), InventorySummary sublabel, and RecommendationCard identity — by routing through the existing SYSTEM_LABELS map (Gold→LongShore, Grey→Acme thread); never surface the internal color enum.

Rein in the blown gold budget (§5): promote the Settings '+ Add' utility links to neutral (high), demote the Ops inventory-companion per-rig/per-row accent to neutral+divider, and get Alex's call on the Inventory deployed-at-two-altitudes and Command IC-gold-twice consolidations.

Apply the Card Anatomy v2 elevation recipe (single-token box-shadow + sunlight override — never the comma-list form that drops when a token is 'none') to the flat border-only containers: the Settings checklist card and all three Cutting Station cards, so content out-elevates chrome.

Bundle the housekeeping: raise every sub-56px tap target to the floor (Settings drag grip + Edit/Remove, Cutting back + saw chips, Command assign/grow rows + 44px cluster, Inventory ImportFlow), promote the 5 full-region empty states to the EmptyState primitive, delete the .fs-cmd-op-fill 1s-linear transition (snap width; also fixes the reduced-motion escape) and snap the two off-scale Ops motion values, and — since the two stat-strip recipes have genuinely drifted (column-stack + uppercase label vs inline-baseline + caption label) — reconcile them into the shared StatStrip primitive.
